test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The new employee is really trying to fit in, but sometimes he feels __out of place and uncomfortable.__
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **a fish out of water**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"a fish out of water"** refers to a person who feels uncomfortable or out of place in a particular situation. (असहज और अलग-थलग महसूस करना) • **Example:** When she moved to a new country, she felt like a fish out of water because everything was so unfamiliar. • The sentence mentions the new employee feeling "out of place and uncomfortable," which aligns perfectly with the meaning of "a fish out of water." (हिंदी में: वह नई परिस्थितियों में खुद को असहज और अलग-थलग महसूस कर रहा था।) • **Example:** Despite his efforts to adjust, the new employee felt like a fish out of water in the corporate environment. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: A diamond in the rough** (कच्चा हीरा): Refers to someone or something that has potential but needs refinement. • **Example:** He is a diamond in the rough, with the right training, he could become a great leader. • **Option 2: A bird of a feather** (एक जैसे विचारों वाले लोग): Refers to people who have similar interests or characteristics. • **Example:** Those two are birds of a feather; they both love hiking and adventure sports. • **Option 4: A needle in a haystack** (भूसे के ढेर में सुई खोजना): Refers to something that is extremely difficult or almost impossible to find. • **Example:** Finding the right file in this unorganized mess is like looking for a needle in a haystack. 1f6:Tc64, The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Elucidate**.
